svg.title: Quality manager — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as quality manager, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: A quality-control plot has upper and lower limits with a measured trace between them. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
